description: Two tall stacks of large, colorful soft LEGO-style blocks stand on the table, with a few loose pieces nearby. The right hand brings a light gray block in from the right and presses it onto the top of the shorter stack, then later lifts a red block and sets it on top of that same stack before picking up a long green baseplate, turning it slightly in the air, and placing it down on the table to the right; the left hand holds a red block near the bottom center and then relaxes as the right hand finishes stacking.
